verdict.rationale: DOR documents a mail rail for the business license application: complete the Business License Application, any additional forms, and payment, and mail them to the address on the form, with processing of up to six weeks. The page itself does not publish the mailing address, and excise/B&O returns are explicitly required through MyDOR online, so no paper filing fallback is shown for tax filing. missing for 10: exact mailing address published on the page, a fax number or fax channel, a paper fallback form and address for excise/B&O returns, clear documentation of what the 24/7 phone line can complete, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: By mail complete the Business License Application, along with any additional forms, and payment to the address on the form. Mailed applications can take up to six weeks to process.
